title: When Parameter Gradient Flows Close in Representation Space
abstract: arXiv:2610.27474v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The represented gradient flow of a parameterized model depends on a mobility that can retain hidden parameter information. We study when one entire represented mobility map works for every autonomous loss from one fixed initialization. For two-factor matrix representations wider than both output dimensions, with individually full-row-rank factors, we classify all admissible joint ranks: closure occurs precisely at effective scalar-balanced minimal joint rank or a two-value signed spectral family at full joint rank. All intermediate ranks are excluded; positive represented flows belong to known square-root families. For general representations with constant ambient representation and gradient-Lie ranks, ordinary closure is equivalent to a local invariant-level metric in the analytic case and specified smooth regimes. translated_title: 参数梯度流何时在表示空间中闭合
translated_abstract: 参数化模型的表示梯度流依赖于一种能够保留隐藏参数信息的“可动性”。我们研究了在何种条件下，从固定初始化出发，整张表示的可动性映射能够对每一个自洽损失函数都成立。对于宽度大于两个输出维度、且各因子分别行满秩的双因子矩阵表示，我们分类了所有可允许的联合秩：闭合恰好发生在有效标量平衡的最小联合秩处，或发生在满联合秩下的二值带符号谱族处。所有中间秩均被排除；正的表示流属于已知的平方根族。对于具有常值环境表示与常值梯度-李秩的一般表示，在解析情形以及特定的光滑情形下，通常意义下的闭合等价于一个局部不变量层次的度量。一个端点截面迫使最初不受限制的可动性映射在表示（原文摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文精确刻画了表示梯度流对所有损失函数发生闭合的条件：在行满秩的双因子矩阵表示中，闭合仅发生在有效标量平衡的最小联合秩或满联合秩的二值带符号谱族处，而所有中间秩均被排除。
en_tdlr: The paper classifies exactly when represented gradient flows close for every loss from a fixed initialization: for wide two-factor matrix representations with full-row-rank factors, closure occurs precisely at the minimal scalar-balanced joint rank or at full joint rank with a two-value signed spectral family, excluding all intermediate ranks.
